If an engine backfires, it experiences a premature ignition of fuel or exhaust gases, making a popping sound.
If something backfires, it failed in a manner that brings an opposite and undesirable effect to what was intend.
m.e: His attempt to make money by importing luxury cars backfired horribly when fuel prices tripled.
